description: Reads the state, the pending items and the met items, with reasons, actions and evidence. It never starts an analysis. Pending items group precisa_comprovar (proof missing), divergente (incompatible evidence) and acompanhar (future obligation). A different company record, attachments or dossier return outdated without current results. The reference date stays when the analysis resumes; a previous day returns data_atual=false. Validated batches stay available during failures or processing, with parcial=true and processados/total; they never mean that the requirements not yet compared are done. GET does not run the queue and does not start AI.
